# netbox_custom_field (Data Source)

A NetBox custom field definition (extras.customfield). Values are set per object via the custom_fields attribute.

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/customization/custom-fields/#custom-fields):

> Each model in NetBox is represented in the database as a discrete table, and each attribute of a model exists as a column within its table. For example, sites are stored in the dcim_site table, which has columns named name, facility, physical_address, and so on. As new attributes are added to objects throughout the development of NetBox, tables are expanded to include new rows.
>
> However, some users might want to store additional object attributes that are somewhat esoteric in nature, and that would not make sense to include in the core NetBox database schema. For instance, suppose your organization needs to associate each device with a ticket number correlating it with an internal support system record. This is certainly a legitimate use for NetBox, but it's not a common enough need to warrant including a field for every NetBox installation. Instead, you can create a custom field to hold this data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_custom_field" "test" {
  name = "test_custom_field"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) NetBox id of the custom field.
- `name` (String) Internal field name (also the key in custom_fields).

### Read-Only

- `choice_set_id` (Number) Id of the choice set (select and multiselect fields).
- `created` (String)
- `default` (String) Default value as JSON text, e.g. jsonencode("foo") or jsonencode(5).
- `description` (String)
- `filter_logic` (String) How the field is matched when filtering. One of: disabled, loose, exact.
- `group_name` (String) Custom fields in the same group are shown together.
- `label` (String) Human-readable label.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object types the field applies to, e.g. dcim.site.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `related_object_type` (String) Content type of the related objects for object and multiobject fields, e.g. dcim.device.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether a value is required when creating objects.
- `type` (String) Field data type. One of: text, longtext, integer, decimal, boolean, date, datetime, url, json, select, multiselect, object, multiobject.
- `url` (String)
- `validation_maximum` (Number) Maximum allowed value (numeric fields).
- `validation_minimum` (Number) Minimum allowed value (numeric fields).
- `validation_regex` (String) Regular expression text values must match.
- `weight` (Number) Order within a group.
